caption: The drawing consists of five circular and oval objects, each distinct in design and color, arranged in a loose cluster on a neutral, light-colored background. In the upper left is an oval object with a golden-brown outer border and a darker brown, irregularly shaped center. In the upper right is a smaller circle featuring a grayscale portrait of a person's head, bordered with a thin golden ring. At the center of the drawing is the largest circle, with a pinkish and light green background, surrounded by a scalloped black border, and a symmetrical black pattern with small white accents in the middle. At the bottom left is a round object with a bright turquoise center, bordered by a thin yellow ring and an outer ring of gold, beaded segments. At the bottom right is a dark brown circular object, bordered with a jagged silver outline, containing a design of a branch with three silver-white ovals and a leaf.
title: Buttons
